normalization: E[sum of cleared tiles in extra waves that still advance the goal] / initial goal Q
weighting: equal weights and uniform Random reference policy
fit: V4 only, original 100 certified boards, midpoint after positions 33 and 66 in ascending ease
comparison: Reused prior confirmation cohort, independent of the 100 calibration boards. This is the first V4 comparison and not a new blind cohort for this research direction.
primary: Macro mean Spearman of model ease against P1 and P2 for Greedy, Objective and Lookahead within each recipe, equal weight per nonconstant cell; same metric as the prior ablation.

bootstrap.unit: whole boards resampled within each recipe, paired across models and agents

diagnostics: Display all recipe-agent endpoints and tier coverage; separately compare productive rate against P1/P2/P3 and total overshoot on Random within each recipe; use rank residualization against Random P1/P2 to inspect independent association with the other agent endpoints without changing the fitted model.
